accuracy_note: No independent pixel ground truth; repeated coordinates do not alone establish error for stationary scenes. Actual moving/deforming examples show clear misses.

findings.source0000000: Cooking meat/oil localized coarsely but visible steam excluded.
findings.source0000053: Bottle and glass reasonably covered; narrow liquid process not separately resolved.
findings.source0000579: Entire image box offers almost no physical-localization discrimination.
findings.wisa0029131: Copies first-frame box; later bent head and torso extend outside.
findings.wisa0028206: Coarse central material box; not evidence that melting process or its timing is correct.
findings.wisa0025412: Static trough box misses changing lower/front ball regions.
findings.wisa0032401: Entire image box, not a useful local process target.
findings.source0001535: Early smoke box then empty observations despite clearly expanded smoke; unacceptable missed physical regions.

decision: Do not scale or train with v2 boxes. Evaluate independent image grounding with shared whole-video context. Bounding boxes are coarse participation supervision, not physical truth or deformation constraints.
